reason: The inference that the Hermitian symmetrization preserves the value at J silently requires J^dagger=J: psi_sharp(J)=overline(psi(J^dagger)) equals 1 only under self-adjointness. Node 1.2 states only that J is norm one and declares no dependency/validated child supplying J^dagger=J. Concrete counterexample to the stated reasoning: take A=C with its usual norm and involution z^dagger=overline(z), J=i, and the complex-linear norm-one functional psi(z)=-iz satisfying psi(J)=1. Then psi_sharp(z)=iz, so psi_sharp(J)=-1 and phi=(psi+psi_sharp)/2=0, hence phi(J)=0 rather than 1. Indeed no Hermitian complex-linear phi can satisfy phi(i)=1. The node needs an explicit self-adjointness premise or a valid dependency supplying it.
